name: H10 BIM Progress Dashboard
tagline: Client-facing project + BIM progress, from pre-design to final GFC.
description: A live dashboard that communicates project and BIM progress to clients — stage timeline, discipline status, and a clear explanation of how the delivery works, in the studio design language.

page.objective: Give clients a single, always-current view of project and BIM progress.
page.problem: Progress updates were manual, inconsistent, and time-consuming to assemble each week.
page.solution: A structured dashboard that presents stage timeline, discipline status and process clarity in one place.

highlights.headline: One dashboard, four roles: BIM Director, Manager, Consultant and Client.
points: Role selector switches the whole view — Director, Manager, MEP consultant, client.
Tracks every discipline's Pre-GFC and Final GFC gateway dates against target.
Upcoming-deadlines rail is built from the same gateway data, not a separate feed.
